A subscription should provide meaningful value, not become another gateway to endless charges. The pricing model feels designed to drain your wallet rather than provide a satisfying user experience. Credits disappear quickly, and generating even a handful of videos can become ridiculously expensive. The technology has potential, but the aggressive monetization ruins the experience.
